seoDescription: Your space is already deciding how you live. A free first conversation, or a consultation, with Petrina Salema in Vienna.
hook: Your space is already deciding how you live. Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose. Shape the rooms that define how you want to rest, gather, and think.

projectOffer.title: Full project
projectOffer.body: This is a redesign of how a home or a room operates. It's about how a family or guests move through it, and then about the layout, materials, sourcing, and styling.
projectOffer.note: I take on a few residences a year. Most of them take one to three months, in person in Vienna, and remotely abroad.
projectOffer.finance: You'll get a quote after the first conversation. A deposit starts the project, and then billing goes in stages until the last invoice.

jumpstartOffer.title: Consultation
jumpstartOffer.body: In one hour, get a clear point of view on the change that would matter most adapting your rooms into a space that shapes the way you want to live.
